# Paired historical failure diagnostic v1

Derived from the existing frozen predictions; no new fitting or model selection.

model MAE minus baseline MAE; positive means model is worse. All MAEs and deltas use rentals/hour.

Target clock hour equals zero-based horizon for the daily 00:00 origin; horizon 0 is 00:00.

Observed paired targets: 3488. Model loses on 2/5 months, 8/24 hours, 65/147 days.

## Limits

- Post-hoc descriptive slices of the same final holdout; no retuning or retraining.
- Only targets observed for both methods are scored; missing target hours are not zero.
- No uncertainty interval, statistical significance or other-city guarantee.
- Day and hour slices are correlated observations, not independent experiments.

Input and implementation SHA-256 hashes are in `diagnostics-v1.json`.
